AnchorsChoice.description: The Start and End item ids (HC-2): POIs of the project, one POI for both on a round trip; `null` unsets one.
AnchorsChoice.title: AnchorsChoice

DiagnosticsResource.description:
`GET /api/diagnostics` (DV-3, kpi-contracts `diagnostics_endpoint`) over the last `days` days. `k1`, `k4`,
`g1`, `g2` and `cache_hit_rate_30d` stay null until the slices that own their sources.
DiagnosticsResource.title: DiagnosticsResource

G4Resource.description: Plan requests refused for a routing engine that was unreachable or not ready, over the window asked for.
G4Resource.title: G4Resource

IncumbentResource.description:
The last valid route found while optimising: its legs not yet confirmed, its retraces, the optimizer's cost of
it and when it was found, in seconds from the job's start.
IncumbentResource.title: IncumbentResource

ItemResource.description: A catalog item (D107): `location` for a POI; `entry`, `exit` and `length_m` for a track; others null.
ItemResource.title: ItemResource

K2Resource.description: Plan runs that broke a hard rule (Failed with `internal_invariant_violation`): `all_time` and `window`.
K2Resource.title: K2Resource

K3Resource.description: Plan runs whose stops left out an item they were asked to visit: `all_time` and `window`.
K3Resource.title: K3Resource

K5Resource.description:
Planning time, a server-side proxy (D177): nearest-rank p95 in seconds (the max below 20 jobs) over the cold
jobs of the window, done, failed and cancelled alike; per-band fields are keyed le_30, 31_59, 60, 61_70 and a band
without a job shows null. `e2e_source` names what e2e measures (`elapsed_ms` until slice 06a). The counts are
shown apart and stay in every p95, except memo hits, which are not cold plans.
K5Resource.title: K5Resource

K7Resource.description: Done jobs per project and local day (Europe/Rome), projects named '__...' left out; null without a job.
K7Resource.title: K7Resource

MapConfig.description:
What the web needs to draw its maps (ADR-004): the Terrain raster tile address, its credit and the deepest zoom,
the light base map's style address and credit (Amendment 1), and the area the road map covers.
MapConfig.title: MapConfig

PlanJobAccepted.description:
Calculate's answer: the job to poll and the notices of the project planned, such as "Large project -
calculation may take longer than 3 minutes" above 60 Included items (D146).
PlanJobAccepted.title: PlanJobAccepted

PlanJobResource.title: PlanJobResource

PlanReportResource.description:
Why a Failed run has no plan, in product words (D206); the code stays in `failure_reason`. `items` names the
items an `unreachable` run is about, empty for any other run and for a report stored before 07-05.
PlanReportResource.title: PlanReportResource

PlanRunDetailResource.description:
A plan run with its ordered stops and totals; a Failed run has neither, names its `failure_reason` and keeps the
reason in product words in `report`. A ready run shows `report` null, as does any run stored before 05-08; a run
stored before the totals were (0006) shows `totals` null. `reproducible` and `not_fully_optimised` are the run
flags (`not_fully_optimised`: `optimizer_failed`, `time_limit` or `stopped`); `messages` the lines the results show
in words, composed from the run's stored facts, such as "Planned 60 items in 2 min 41 s", "not fully optimised
(time limit)", "Reused the identical plan of run #N" or, for a run failed on the feasibility limit, "No valid route
found within the time limit - plan run #N failed" (D151); a run stored before 06-10 has no run time line.
`memo_hit` is true when the run reused an earlier run's plan: "Re-optimise (ignore previous result)" is offered.
`provider_header` names the road map the run was planned on, from what it stored: "Provider: Valhalla (map data
2026-11-01) / profile: 4x4", or "Provider: offline estimate (straight line x 1.3) / profile: estimate".
`estimate` is true when the roads are that offline road map: the planner says so, and so does the
exported file (D267, D268).
PlanRunDetailResource.title: PlanRunDetailResource

PlanRunResource.description:
A numbered plan run; a job still running has none. `stale`: the project changed since it was computed.
`reproducible` is false when its search did not end on its budget; `not_fully_optimised` names why a ready run is
not (brief section 8 run flags), null otherwise.
PlanRunResource.title: PlanRunResource

PlanStopResource.description:
One stop of the itinerary (FR-6.1): the first has no road leg; a track shows its entry and exit (HC-1), its
length and off-road time, a POI none. Km and seconds are unrounded; a run stored before them shows them null.
A retrace is its own row, `type` "retrace", right after its track, with its own `confidence` and `reason`; a stop
reached by road shows the `leg_confidence` of that road and, when Unconfirmed, its `leg_reason`.
PlanStopResource.title: PlanStopResource

PoiCreate.description: A place by decimal degrees. The ranges are the domain's rule (D151 reasons), so they are not checked here.
PoiCreate.title: PoiCreate

ProjectUpdate.description:
The project's settings, at least one: `objective` (`distance` or `time`) and/or the off-road speed. Their rules
(a known objective, a speed above 0 and finite, one at least given) are the domain's, not checked here.
ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate

RunGeometryResource.description:
A run's map data (D251): a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, the lines in itinerary order and then the markers. A line's
`stop` is the 1-based itinerary row it leads to or belongs to; `geometry` `unavailable` marks a road leg drawn as a
straight line because its shape could not be fetched (D253); a `start_end` marker carries the End's number in
`end_stop`.
RunGeometryResource.title: RunGeometryResource

TotalsResource.description: The plan's road, off-road and total driving (FR-6.2), in km and seconds, unrounded: rounding is the web's.
TotalsResource.title: TotalsResource

get.description: K2, K3, K5 and K7 over the last `days` days; `project_id` limits every figure to that project.

schema.title: Response Api Health Api Health Get

get.description: `plan_run_id` stays null until the run is stored. 404 `not_found` for an unknown or expired id.

post.description:
"Stop and use best so far" (US-06b, D136): always 200 with the current poll payload, repeated Stops change
nothing. While solving the job ends with the best route so far, labelled, or Failed `stopped` without one;
before solving it ends `cancelled` with no run; once `stoppable` is false the run being written completes.
404 `not_found` for an unknown or expired id.

get.description:
The stops in order, track stops with their entry and exit, and the unrounded totals; a Failed run has no
stops and no totals and names its reason; a run stored before the totals were shows `totals` null.

Changes nothing. 404 `not_found` for an unknown run; 422 `validation_error` for a Failed run or when a
track's stored points are not the ones the run recorded. A sync handler, so a big track never holds up the
event loop. The file name is safe to quote: `run_file_name` answers only `[a-z0-9-]`, a run number and `.gpx`.

The run's lines and markers as one GeoJSON FeatureCollection in itinerary order (D251): road legs, tracks in
the direction they are driven and retraces, numbered stops, entry and exit markers and one `start_end` marker
for a round trip. A road leg whose shape cannot be fetched is a straight line with `geometry` `unavailable`
(D253): the answer is still 200. 404 `not_found` for an unknown run, and for a Failed run ("This plan run
has no route to draw").

schema.title: Response List Projects Api Projects Get

patch.description:
Sets the objective and/or the off-road speed (one more revision when one differs); an unknown objective, a
speed of 0 or less or not finite, or a body naming neither answers 422 and nothing changes.

put.description:
Replaces Start and End; `null` leaves one unset. Unknown ids answer 404; a track or another project's item
422; nothing changes.

get.description: Every item in the order added, or only those of `type`; an unknown type answers 422.

schema.title: Response Project Items Api Projects  Project Id  Items Get

delete.description: Clears any anchor the item held; an unknown item or one of another project answers 404; plan runs stay.

schema.title: Response Project Plan Runs Api Projects  Project Id  Plan Runs Get

post.description:
Answers at once with the job to poll. Refused with 422 `missing_anchor`, 409 `job_active` or 503
`optimizer_unavailable`: no job and no plan run. `ignore_memo=true` ("Re-optimise (ignore previous result)")
has the same refusals; a value that is not a boolean answers 422 `validation_error`. `notices` holds the
large-project notice above 60 Included items (D146): the plan is calculated all the same.
Out-of-range coordinates or a blank name answer 422 `validation_error` with the reason; nothing is added.
All or nothing (D149): when any file is refused, 422 (or 413 for the caps) names it and nothing is added.

schema.title: Response Import Tracks Api Projects  Project Id  Tracks Post
